text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: KV-cache eviction rate spiked x12 in last 3m for nodepool-prod-3. p95 latency > 900ms for mixed-model routes (mistral-7b + qwen-7b). Possible continuous-batching amplification. Auto-scaling not keeping up. Paging alice (oncall).

alice: oncall ack, looking. any customer-facing errors? @support-bot can you check 5xx trends by org?

support-bot: orgs with increased 5xxs: ACME_CORP (+4% 5xx over baseline), BetaHealth (+2%). Error class: upstream 502 from runtime, timeouts from runtime-proxy. No errors from API layer.

alice: thanks. bob, can you look at runtime batching config and KV-prefetch metrics? suspect prefetch + long tail prompts causing cache churn.

bob: diving in. I can throttle continuous_batch.window_ms and reduce max_batch_tokens. pulling up config now.

carol: ML note: Qwen variants using MQA appear to generate larger per-request KV keys because of padding; prefetch for GQA and MQA mixed traffic can cause eviction storms. we should disable prefetch for qwen-*-mqa in prod for now.

dave: also seeing headroom issue on pool nodepool-prod-3 — 98% GPU mem due to larger activations. This is forcing more evictions. scaling won't help immediately.

bob: preparing hotfix. plan: 1) set continuous_batch.window_ms from 30 -> 10 2) set continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens from 4096 -> 2048 3) flip kv.prefetch.enabled=false for model_tag:qwen-mqa 4) apply per-route throttles to reduce burst concurrency for MQA routes. will roll to nodepool-prod-3 first.

bob: running command now:
```
PATCH /runtime/configs/nodepool-prod-3
{ "continuous_batch": { "window_ms": 10, "max_batch_tokens": 2048 },
  "kv": { "prefetch": { "enabled_for_tags": ["!qwen-mqa"] } }
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy started by bob @ 2209876678. Jobs: config-patch, rolling-restart nodepool-prod-3.

alice: watching metrics. dashboard link: https://console.redwood.dev/d/kv-live/kv-evictions?from=now-1h. please paste p95 after deploy.

bob: rolled to nodepool-prod-3 at 2209876780. restarting runtime pods in sequence.

dave: immediate drop in eviction-rate by ~65% on nodes patched. p95 latency dropped from 920ms -> 410ms in 30s. GPU mem usage down ~6%.

evelyn: support note: ACME_CORP incidents decreased; opening postmortem contact: assigned to evelyn to notify impacted accounts with explanation and mitigations.

alice: thanks team. current status: partially mitigated, monitoring for 15m. escalation: if p95 > 600ms again, will escalate to infra oncall and consider emergency route-fallback to smaller model (mistral-3b) for affected tenants. handoff to bob for 2209877001 to continue monitoring and follow-up.

bob: taking handoff. cread: disable prefetch for qwen-mqa across all nodepools in 10m if metrics hold. will open follow-up ticket with root-cause triage steps and perf-regression test.

support-bot: note for customer comms: "We mitigated a KV cache prefetch amplification that caused higher latency for mixed MQA/GQA workloads. Temporary config changes applied; longer-term fix under investigation." 

alice: handoff complete. oncall clear for now but will remain in thread for updates. :thumbsup:
